purpose: Source-authored predicate contract for custom Conflux law profiles that require mixed elemental family composition. This records elemental-family mix semantics only; it does not prove live party enumeration, battle stack identity, temporary summon exclusion, day-phase state, reward trigger ordering, or authorize gameplay mutation.
requiredRuntimeProof: law owner to party or battle side correlation proof
idempotent reward or trigger application proof

forbiddenSubstitutes: any elemental unit count
same elemental family duplicates counted as a mix
Conflux faction membership counted as elemental family mix
SID substring elemental inference
display-name elemental inference
temporary summoned elemental counted without summon exclusion proof
conflux.mixed-elemental-composition.notes: Conflux mixed elemental composition requires at least two distinct authored elemental families in the relevant formation/composition context, not just any elemental unit or Conflux membership.
